title: Smooth-locus normalization of the nodal adjunction comparison
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $C,N$ schemes [def-pc-scheme], $p:C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, $r:N\to C$, and $F$ a supplied relative-rank-one adjunction system for $p$ [def-sfb-flat-lci-adjunction-system]. Write $L=F_{\mathrm{id}}$ for its line at the identity base-change record [def-sfb-flat-lci-base-change]. Let $B$ be a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf on $N$, with its inclusion $j_B:B\to\mathcal O_N$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Write $B^\vee=\mathcal{H}om(B,\mathcal O_N)$ for the module dual [def-sc-invertible-module] and $\tau_B\in\Gamma(N,B^\vee)$ for the section corresponding to $j_B$. Given an isomorphism $e:r^*L\xrightarrow\sim\Omega^1_{N/k}\otimes B^\vee$, where pullback and relative differentials are [def-pc-module-pullback] and [def-sc-kahler-differentials], define the predicate that $e$ is the smooth-locus-normalized nodal normalization adjunction comparison as follows. For every open immersion $i:U\hookrightarrow C$ with $p|_U$ smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], every smooth comparison $e_U:i^*L\xrightarrow\sim\bigwedge^1\Omega^1_{U/k}$ normalized by the conormal-first determinant rule of $F$ (exterior sheaf and wedge of sections as in [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]), every $a\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_C)$, and every $m\in\Gamma(U,L)$, if $e_U(i^*m)=\bigwedge^1 d(i^\sharp a)$ on $i^{-1}U$, then $e(r^*m)=d(r^\sharp a)\otimes\tau_B$ on $r^{-1}U$. Here pullback of sections is the canonical tensor-pullback section map. This predicate imposes no extra properness, smoothness, nodality, normalization, or invertibility hypothesis on the supplied objects, and asserts no existence of $e$; those geometric hypotheses belong to the theorems using it.
